subject: Approval needed: Hosted API pricing exception for HelioMed (25% off requested)
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliomed.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioMed hosted usage forecast + pricing ask

Hi Irene / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HelioMed is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the KV caching approach. We're preparing an internal proposal for a multi-region rollout. Based on our internal usage model, we're estimating ~1.2B tokens/month across production + staging after month 3 (see attached usage-forecast-helio.csv).

Given that scale, procurement is requesting a non-standard commercial concession: a 25% discount off published Hosted API usage rates for the first 12 months (with a commitment to a 12-month minimum spend). Can you confirm whether Redwood can support this level of discount and any gating conditions?

I've attached a short MA plan and the procurement PO template for your legal team to review. We're trying to get pricing locked by Nov 8 to align with our board cadence.

Thanks,
Sara Lopez
Head of ML Platforms, HelioMed
Attachments: usage-forecast-helio.csv (csv), HelioMed_MA_Plan_v3.pdf (pdf)
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliomed.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed hosted usage forecast + pricing ask

Sara — thanks for the forecast and the context. This is a meaningful opportunity and we appreciate the clear timeline. Quick notes:

- We typically approve up to 20% off list for committed Hosted API volume at the deal desk level. Anything >20% requires an exception and exec sign-off because of unit economics and capacity planning.
- I'll start the internal uplift/summary and escalate for approval. Can you confirm whether the 12-month minimum is firm and whether the volumes are guaranteed (committed) vs. expected (best-effort)? Committed dollars change the approval calculus.

I'll loop in Deal Desk and Revenue Ops with a short MA and the forecast. Expect an update within 48 hours.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliomed.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, procurement@heliomed.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioMed hosted usage forecast + pricing ask

Hi Irene — thanks. 12-month minimum is firm from our side; procurement can commit to the minimum spend in the PO. Volumes are expected to follow the forecast conservatively (we can agree a ramp schedule with milestones tied to the payments).

We are requesting 25% off list for the first 12 months as a condition of selecting Redwood — the alternative vendors are offering deeper concessions if we do not take a committed plan. We also have a preference for an onboarding credit to offset initial integration costs.

Can you share what information Deal Desk needs to present to execs? Happy to provide a short one-pager or attend a call.

Thanks,
Sara
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HelioMed hosted usage forecast + pricing ask — request for >20% concession approval

Marissa — forwarding HelioMed's ask. Summary below for quick review:

- Account: HelioMed Solutions (Healthcare / diagnostics)
- Request: 25% off Hosted API usage rates for first 12 months (they will sign a 12-month minimum spend)
- Forecast: ~1.2B tokens/month post-ramp; conservative ramp over 3 months (see attached forecast)
- Economics: estimated billed revenue year 1 = $X (redacted internal calc here), gross margin sensitive to discount >20% 
- Commercial ask: approve a 25% concession and a $50k onboarding credit; Legal will need to accept a short amendment.

Why approve? Strategic enterprise in healthcare, multi-region presence, reference potential, and likely Dedicated interest in 18-24 months. Risk: the initial months are high-throughput and will require priority capacity planning.

Attachments: usage-forecast-helio.csv, HelioMed_MA_Plan_v3.pdf, redlines_hostedapi_amendment.docx

Can you advise next steps for exec approval? If you think >20% is viable with conditions, please route to Jonas for sign-off; otherwise propose cap/alternative concession.

—Aditya
Director of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request: HelioMed 25% Hosted API concession (need sign-off)

Jonas — request your quick review and sign-off for an exception to standard Hosted API pricing. Details:

- Request: 25% off list for first 12 months + $50k onboarding credit.
- Commitment: HelioMed to sign a 12-month minimum spend (PO provided).
- Forecasted volume: 1.2B tokens/month after ramp (attached forecast).
- Impact: discounted unit economics reduce gross margin on tokens by ~xx percentage points; year 1 ARR still positive but lower than typical deals.
- Recommended gating: require auto-renew at standard published rates after month 12 and a usage true-up mechanism if actuals fall <80% of committed spend in months 4–6. Also require engineering capacity plan and a Dedicated readiness review (to avoid production contention).

Attached: redlines_hostedapi_amendment.docx (legal redlines), usage-forecast-helio.csv.

Given timeline (customer board Nov 8), we need a sign-off today or earliest tomorrow. Appreciate a short note if approved and any additional conditions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redlines_hostedapi_amendment.docx
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: HelioMed 25% Hosted API concession (need sign-off)

Marissa — approved with conditions.

Decision: APPROVE 25% concession for first 12 months, plus $50k one-time onboarding credit.

Conditions:
1) Customer executes a 12-month minimum spend PO that is attached to the HubSpot deal and stored with Finance.
2) Auto-renew to standard published rates at month 13 unless renegotiated with Deal Desk approval.
3) Include a performance/usage true-up clause: if actual billed usage <80% of committed spend in months 4–6, net revenue adjustment applies and the onboarding credit will be clawed back pro rata.
4) Engineering must confirm capacity plan (capacity reservation or Dedicated migration runway).
5) Legal to accept the proposed amendment redlines; deal can only sign once Legal OKs the amendment.

Finance: please record a concession allowance for the forecasted revenue impact and add this to the deal record (Deal ID RWI-DEAL-2026-0927-HEM).

Marissa/Aditya — please notify the customer and ask Sara to provide final PO by EOD Nov 4. I will follow up with a short exec note if needed.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
